greeting.text: Ah, a new face. Welcome. I don't believe we've been introduced — I handle matters of currency and accounts in these parts.

choices.text: What exactly do you do here?
I'd like to open an account.
I'd like to make a deposit or withdrawal.
Good to know. I'll be on my way.

services.text: Credit accounts, currency exchange, the occasional investment for those I trust. Bring me coin worth safeguarding, and I'll keep it far from harm's reach. Come find me again once you've something worth depositing.

open_account.text: A wise decision. A Basic Account runs 100 Credits to set up — non-negotiable, as a rule. Do you have that much on you?

choices.text: [100 CREDITS] Of course, here you go.
[PERSUASION DC 12] Nothing on me, but I'd still like an account.
[WIZARD] [INVESTIGATION DC 15] Point out the clerical error in your fee structure.

account_opened.text: Excellent. Consider yourself banked — I'll keep an eye on your ledger from here.

account_opened_empty.text: ...Very well. Not everyone convinces me so easily. Consider yourself banked, empty ledger and all — try not to make me regret it.

account_opened_critical.text: ...That may be the finest argument I've heard in years. Fine — no deposit required at all, and I'll make a note of your name for future considerations.

account_opened_critical_end.text: See to it you live up to that impression.

account_declined.text: A fair try, but I'll need those 100 Credits before your name goes in the ledger. Come back when you've got them.

account_declined_critical.text: No. In fact, I'd ask you not to return until you have something worth my time.

account_opened_intimidated.text: ...(his hand trembles slightly as he reaches for the ledger) ...Of course. No charge needed. Consider it done.

account_opened_intimidated_critical.text: ...(he actually takes a step back) There's truly no need for that. Take the account. Take whatever you need. Just go easy on the furniture.

account_opened_intimidated_critical_end.text: Please. Take your business elsewhere next time.

account_declined_intimidated.text: You can loom all you like — I've dealt with worse than you. No account without payment.

account_declined_intimidated_critical.text: (he doesn't even flinch) I've had actual monsters try that line on me. Get out of my bank.

account_opened_investigated.text: ...(he frowns, flipping through his ledger) ...Well, I'll be. You're right — that clause is in violation of our own bylaws. Fine. Account opened, no charge, and my thanks for the correction.

account_opened_investigated_end.text: Do come back if you find anything else... unusual.

account_opened_investigated_critical.text: (stunned) I've overseen this branch for over a decade and never noticed that. You have my full attention — and my ledger, apparently. No charge, and consider yourself a person of interest for future business.

account_opened_investigated_critical_end.text: I imagine we'll be seeing more of each other.

account_declined_investigated.text: An admirable attempt, but I've heard cleverer arguments from actual auditors. The fee stands.

account_declined_investigated_critical.text: (unimpressed) That's not even the right ledger. Good day.
